correctness.rationale: The known rational plateau criterion L(λ)<=b<=U(λ) with ceil/floor mechanical word supplies the starting point. Prefix-dominance of initial mechanical factors gives L,U strictly decreasing; L<U inside (0,1), both have endpoints 1 and p/q, hence inverse slope interval. Coprime floor-sum yields S(1)=p, S'(1)=(p-1)(q-1)/2 and L'(1)=-(q-1)/(2q), U'(1)=-(q+1)/(2q); analytic inversion gives width coefficient 4q/(q²-1). Independent exact first-moment arithmetic held for all coprime 1<=p<q<=29. Critically, the identical all-domain proof is also available in two earlier publications.
residual_risks: Only rational reduced target and fixed p,q near b=p/q; no uniform-in-q expansion.
